rules.openings: One playable prologue per power signature. These are hero/student perspective events; never just a renamed tutorial.
rules.lairs: One villain-exclusive tactical location per stable villain identity; must include a phase-changing environment, meaningful secret and showdown against a lieutenant.
rules.lieutenant: One named second-in-command per villain above one-hit species, 4 HP initial benchmark, separate from minor species captain and any other permanent hero.

opening.title: The Last Order
opening.venue: Neon Row all-night diner
opening.inciting: Grease fire traps the cook behind a locked delivery hatch.
opening.powerUse: Redirect heat through the kitchen hood to make a cool rescue lane.
opening.choice: Save the staff immediately or salvage the proof of an insurance scam.

lair.title: The Underwriters' Furnace
lair.venue: Insurance exchange built inside an abandoned municipal incinerator
lair.arena: Sprinkler valves switch protection from one row to another, turning yesterday's safe route into the ignition path.
lair.objective: Break the policy press before it issues citywide fire claims.
lair.secret: Charred menus reveal customers being billed for fires not yet started.

lieutenant.name: Vera Vellum
lieutenant.look: Fireproof adjuster in soot-black opera gloves and a suit stitched with red insurance ribbons.
lieutenant.power: Forecloses an ally's cover then turns that tile into a delayed fireburst.
lieutenant.counter: Her giant red approval stamp must touch a wall; destroy it or disrupt the stamp.
lieutenant.agenda: Cares for the restaurant workers whose livelihoods Backdraft calls collateral.

opening.title: Ferris Wheel Without Air
opening.venue: Comet City pier carnival
opening.inciting: Passengers pass out in stalled observation cars as the wheel spins against the wind.
opening.powerUse: Shape a stable air corridor between suspended carriages.
opening.choice: Choose the lowest gondola first or risk everyone to reach the child at the top.

lair.title: The Quiet Vault
lair.venue: Suspended vacuum chambers beneath an elite bank
lair.arena: Airlocks cycle oxygen between pods; moving quickly is unsafe unless pressure is equalized.
lair.objective: Open the emergency intake before the vault's final pressure drop.
lair.secret: Maintenance logs prove Skyline could have left every innocent depositor breathing.

lieutenant.name: Dr. Serein Voss
lieutenant.look: Vacuum physician with translucent glass lungs and a surgeon's silver mask.
lieutenant.power: Creates a two-cell low-pressure zone that suppresses shooting and drags nearby cover.
lieutenant.counter: The lung pumps visibly refill between pulses; sever their hose to end suction.
lieutenant.agenda: Will betray Skyline if promised evacuation for patients in the adjoining hospital.

opening.title: The Street That Sank
opening.venue: Bus stop outside the academy
opening.inciting: A school bus lists into a fresh sinkhole while the street beneath it keeps moving.
opening.powerUse: Raise a temporary earthen ramp without collapsing an old water main.
opening.choice: Save passengers now or keep the neighborhood's fragile water system intact.

lair.title: The Deed Below
lair.venue: Old Quarry sub-basement and occupied tunnel court
lair.arena: Burrowing warning rings appear behind cover; heavy support pillars can collapse new or old exits.
lair.objective: Stop the underground title auction before the surface buildings are repossessed.
lair.secret: Tunnel plans show which tenants Cornerstone deliberately protected.

lieutenant.name: Mags Hardpan
lieutenant.look: Seismic drummer in granite shoulder plates, dragging a bass drum carved from quarry stone.
lieutenant.power: Beats the floor to create chained cracks and pushes units between elevations.
lieutenant.counter: A missing downbeat exposes the resonant drumhead for interruption.
lieutenant.agenda: Protects the Warren Wreckers' union contract and refuses unsafe tunnel orders.

opening.title: Hydrant Blue
opening.venue: Municipal fire station during a heat wave
opening.inciting: Firefighters discover every hydrant is bone-dry with residents still trapped by smoke.
opening.powerUse: Lift and redirect water from a broken underground main.
opening.choice: Flood the engine bay for immediate rescue or ration enough for the next block.

lair.title: The Empty Reservoir
lair.venue: Dry cistern with enormous inverted water columns and pressure gates
lair.arena: Pressure bridges fill and drain on a three-beat cycle, opening and closing firing lanes.
lair.objective: Release captive neighborhood supply before Tidewarden seals the aqueduct.
lair.secret: A hand-marked overflow channel could save the district without yielding to ransom.

lieutenant.name: Solene Spigot
lieutenant.look: Tide-cartographer in a glass diving bell, carrying a rotating brass pressure sextant.
lieutenant.power: Moves entire watery lanes sideways, sweeping units into exposed ground.
lieutenant.counter: Turn the red depth wheel against her sextant to freeze the current.
lieutenant.agenda: Believes water is a right, despite her role collecting the extortion payments.

opening.title: The Clocktower Collapse
opening.venue: School clocktower crowded with graduation banners
opening.inciting: The hands jam while a maintenance platform falls on a timed sequence.
opening.powerUse: Use precisely timed movement to catch the falling lift between gear teeth.
opening.choice: Rescue the technician or preserve the live timing evidence from the sabotage.

lair.title: The Ninety-Second Palace
lair.venue: Circular subway dispatch clock and twelve moving platforms
lair.arena: Every third beat swaps doors and rotating cover, rewarding players who count time.
lair.objective: Stop The Second Hand's synchronized city heist before the final chime.
lair.secret: His master plan leaves ninety-three seconds unaccounted for.

lieutenant.name: Adjutant Tempo
lieutenant.look: Tall metronome fencer with paired conductor batons and a clockwork spine.
lieutenant.power: Grants nearby henchmen a synchronized extra action at the chime.
lieutenant.counter: Break one baton to desynchronize the formation until the next round.
lieutenant.agenda: Secretly schedules recovery time and refuses to make casualties part of the plan.

opening.title: The Equation That Escaped
opening.venue: Academy student science fair
opening.inciting: An experimental proof escapes a whiteboard and unfolds into dangerous autonomous drones.
opening.powerUse: Reconfigure one faulty drone to build an emergency shield instead of attacking.
opening.choice: Publish the error that caused this or privately patch it before people panic.

lair.title: The Red Pen Engine
lair.venue: Labyrinthine aerial drone printer above Comet City's computing vault
lair.arena: Conveyors shift each turn; failed equations are projected onto the squares they will explode.
lair.objective: Stop Eureka's final optimization from deleting living neighborhoods.
lair.secret: An intentionally preserved error reads PLEASE LEAVE ROOM FOR PEOPLE.

lieutenant.name: Professor Minus
lieutenant.look: White-coated ex-teacher with blackboard forearms and rotating chalk halo.
lieutenant.power: Subtracts one AP from targets inside a visible red correction rectangle.
lieutenant.counter: Smear the chalk cornerstone to collapse the attack equation.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants Eureka's work recognized, but opposes turning students into variables.

opening.title: The Unlicensed Rescue
opening.venue: Public library where a benefit concert loses power
opening.inciting: A private hero franchise security team demands a license before evacuating families.
opening.powerUse: Use a signature cape maneuver that works even when a legal force field blocks it.
opening.choice: Protect anonymous volunteers or accept a public sponsorship contract.

lair.title: The Franchise Citadel
lair.venue: Corporate Hall of Heroes with spinning neon trademarks
lair.arena: Legal seal tiles disable named special powers while unbranded cover remains usable.
lair.objective: Seize the original volunteer rescue ledger before it is shredded.
lair.secret: Founding deeds prove the city's earliest cape heroes donated their symbols freely.

lieutenant.name: Counsel Galatea Gilt
lieutenant.look: Corporate knight in holographic robes, powered by a floating notarization desk.
lieutenant.power: Redlines one hero action each round and projects a courtroom shield on an ally.
lieutenant.counter: Read the displayed clause and use an action it doesn't prohibit.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants trademarks to fund public defenders, not Captain Valcourt's monopolies.

opening.title: The Song That Stopped
opening.venue: Community radio tower during a blackout
opening.inciting: A backup broadcast loops a sponsor jingle that turns listeners into a crowd.
opening.powerUse: Create an improvised counter-melody to guide people out of the crush.
opening.choice: Silence all radio or restore a risky channel for emergency messages.

lair.title: The Sponsorship Cathedral
lair.venue: Stadium backstage converted to a cathedral of synchronized advertising screens
lair.arena: Singing towers link across the map and relay attacks; breaking formation weakens the chorus.
lair.objective: Disconnect the sponsored volunteer recruitment feed.
lair.secret: An unsigned jingle gives the audience instructions for breaking its own trance.

lieutenant.name: Maestro Nix Vale
lieutenant.look: Androgynous broadcast conductor in mirrored headphones and an LED-lined cape.
lieutenant.power: Coordinates a multi-tile vocal wave that slides allied targets into new firing lines.
lieutenant.counter: Mute one exposed studio monitor to break the harmonic chain.
lieutenant.agenda: Resents the contracts that make audiences property, despite enjoying their adoration.

opening.title: Ashes of the Ledger
opening.venue: City clinic with endangered mutant medical records
opening.inciting: Officials threaten to burn a clinic's confidential patient charts after a raid.
opening.powerUse: Burn a safe escape hole through reinforced doors without igniting the records.
opening.choice: Expose the illegal registration registry or protect patients' immediate privacy.

lair.title: The Nameless Archive
lair.venue: Fire-blackened registration hall lined with blast-proof rolling shelves
lair.arena: Paper-ash smoke blinds long sightlines while pressurized vents periodically reverse airflow.
lair.objective: Recover the family memory index before Ashborn burns every copy.
lair.secret: A hidden list records successful reunions made possible by carefully kept names.

lieutenant.name: Cinder Tern
lieutenant.look: Heat-born archivist with copper wings made of stitched blank pages.
lieutenant.power: Scatters hot paper shards that pin two targets while smoke hides her movement.
lieutenant.counter: The shard pattern can be broken by turning on the ceiling fans.
lieutenant.agenda: She believes history must survive even when the government records must not.

opening.title: The Balcony Witness
opening.venue: School assembly hall and roof garden
opening.inciting: A messenger bird arrives with evidence just as a hidden sharpshooter fires at it.
opening.powerUse: Redirect a flock through open windows to protect the witness.
opening.choice: Publicly reveal the blackmailers or keep the informant safe at a cost.

lair.title: The Crooked Aviary
lair.venue: Vertical apartment towers joined by secret bird bridges
lair.arena: Crows shuttle objective keys to high perches while blind spots rotate at each alarm.
lair.objective: Intercept the blackmail ledger before its citywide release.
lair.secret: An unsigned letter reveals Kestrel has protected some young witnesses.

lieutenant.name: Madam Rookwire
lieutenant.look: Spymaster in a feather-collared coat with telescoping talons and stained-glass lenses.
lieutenant.power: Splits into mirrored silhouettes at three window perches to issue a coordinated attack.
lieutenant.counter: The real silhouette casts a moving shadow; break the correct perch.
lieutenant.agenda: Collects secrets to defend whistleblowers, not to sell every victim twice.

opening.title: Bridge of Last Chances
opening.venue: Condemned footbridge carrying families to shelter
opening.inciting: A landlord's demolition charges begin their countdown while the bridge is still occupied.
opening.powerUse: Reinforce failing spans with living stone and absorb the next collapse.
opening.choice: Rescue the last family or chase the demolition foreman with the evidence.

lair.title: The Eviction Fault
lair.venue: Seismic platform beneath the luxury tower's foundation
lair.arena: Shockwave pillars rise and fall, shattering static cover and changing elevation.
lair.objective: Stop Groundswell's punitive collapse from crushing the tenants as well as their landlord.
lair.secret: The legal parcel map shows most tenants were never complicit.

lieutenant.name: Kiln Marshal Brack
lieutenant.look: Living concrete ex-inspector with reinforced joints and a surveyor's prism.
lieutenant.power: Stomps a cone of shifting rubble that converts full cover to half cover.
lieutenant.counter: Interrupt the prism beam before the stomp locks onto its tiles.
lieutenant.agenda: Will switch sides if the squatters' evacuation route is genuinely protected.

opening.title: A Ship With No Port
opening.venue: Harbor ferry loaded with displaced families
opening.inciting: Port security turns away a damaged ferry while a storm closes in.
opening.powerUse: Shape a temporary seawall to keep the ferry afloat through rough channels.
opening.choice: Save its engines or negotiate docking rights for everyone aboard.

lair.title: The Container Throne
lair.venue: Flooded customs terminal stacked with floating metal containers
lair.arena: Tides move container cover between lanes and armor plates expose weak joints.
lair.objective: Release ships held for ransom before Harbormaster sinks the navigation buoys.
lair.secret: Dockmaster's log proves an entire neighborhood was never offered a berth.

lieutenant.name: Commander Saltscale
lieutenant.look: Crab-armored former dock pilot in a barnacle crown with mechanical harpoon arms.
lieutenant.power: Anchors two targets together and drags the nearer one through rising water.
lieutenant.counter: Sever the visibly taut tow rope before the pull resolves.
lieutenant.agenda: Demanded safe harbor for mutants long before the boss demanded payment.

opening.title: Four Hands and a Promise
opening.venue: Academy gym during a broken aerial dance rig
opening.inciting: A novice is stranded over a failing apparatus just before a competition final.
opening.powerUse: Use multiple simultaneous limbs to stabilize ropes and escort a partner.
opening.choice: Protect the novice's career or reveal that the championship gear was sabotaged.

lair.title: The Hundred-Hand Arsenal
lair.venue: Repurposed dance conservatory packed with contraband practice weapons
lair.arena: Rotating sparring rigs exchange cover and strike zones on every second beat.
lair.objective: Stop Lotus Guard shipping stolen academy weapons to street gangs.
lair.secret: A hidden practice ledger lists trainees who refused to become soldiers.

lieutenant.name: Director Sable Quoin
lieutenant.look: Eight-legged choreographer in a lacquered armor tutu with brass knuckle shoes.
lieutenant.power: Marks interlocking ribbon arcs, then pulls two fighters into a disarming pirouette.
lieutenant.counter: Cut the central ribbon spool before the fourth count.
lieutenant.agenda: Believes graceful discipline should protect students, not arm recruiters.

opening.title: A Probability of Panic
opening.venue: Graduation rehearsal and a collapsing stage
opening.inciting: A deliberately broken spotlight threatens to trigger three disasters in sequence.
opening.powerUse: Model the domino effects and intervene at the one keystone action.
opening.choice: Save the performers or preserve evidence showing who wrote the forecast.

lair.title: The Unfallen Domino
lair.venue: Abandoned disaster-response simulator disguised as a downtown charity office
lair.arena: Each round reveals the next three cascading calamity tiles; stop one link to change the future.
lair.objective: Interrupt Contingency's self-fulfilling catastrophe protocol.
lair.secret: A wall of predictions contains one disaster he keeps failing to prevent: his own betrayal.

lieutenant.name: Sister Sigma Slip
lieutenant.look: Probability accountant with a face of rotating numbered tiles and long ink-stained sleeves.
lieutenant.power: Places mirrored fail-state markers that redirect an incoming attack onto the nearest piece of cover.
lieutenant.counter: The first marker is false; remove the second to break her probability loop.
lieutenant.agenda: Thinks every model owes a debt to the people excluded from its dataset.

opening.title: Keys to the Shelter
opening.venue: Shelter courtyard during a citywide cold snap
opening.inciting: A heritage shelter locks its doors despite having dozens of empty beds.
opening.powerUse: Use ancestral wards to warm and open a safe route for stranded families.
opening.choice: Challenge the inherited rules publicly or quietly help those outside tonight.

lair.title: The Mercy Ledger
lair.venue: Palatial charity headquarters built around an underground dormitory
lair.arena: Donation-box shield lines roll between cells as shelter doors lock behind every alarm.
lair.objective: Free the residents before The Guardian makes loyalty an eligibility requirement.
lair.secret: Old shelter bylaws recognize residents as joint trustees, not tenants.

lieutenant.name: Regent Mercy Vane
lieutenant.look: Former shelter director in a coat embroidered with room keys and a moving stained-glass halo.
lieutenant.power: Channels two shielded allies into a protective corridor and denies attacks through it.
lieutenant.counter: Ring the resident emergency bell to make her shields answer to the occupants.
lieutenant.agenda: She helped create the shelters and will defend the residents even against Seraphine.

opening.title: The Friend Nobody Remembers
opening.venue: Student council election night
opening.inciting: An elected representative realizes she cannot remember agreeing to a new campaign slate.
opening.powerUse: Find the false memory by retracing one trustworthy relationship.
opening.choice: Expose a friend under coercion or rescue them without revealing their vulnerability.

lair.title: The Universal Welcome
lair.venue: Rotating municipal reception halls where every visitor wears a friendly badge
lair.arena: False-friendly targeting zones shift when the speakers greet players by name.
lair.objective: Shut down Common Ground's trust-forging transmitter.
lair.secret: A sign-in sheet lists people who explicitly refused his 'friendship'.

lieutenant.name: Hostel Zephyr Bell
lieutenant.look: Smiling social engineer wearing a coat of reversible civic uniforms.
lieutenant.power: Marks two allied squares as friendly, then swaps attack permissions for one turn.
lieutenant.counter: Inspect the mismatched badge serial numbers to reveal the deception.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants genuine belonging but fears a city where everyone remembers how they met.

opening.title: The Furnace Lift
opening.venue: Industrial factory with trapped apprentices
opening.inciting: A broken melt crane hangs above a crowded worker exit.
opening.powerUse: Use precision fire-tech to weld a support bridge without overheating it.
opening.choice: Save the apprentices or preserve the whistleblower's broken machine logs.

lair.title: The Brass Volcano
lair.venue: Steelworks converted into a self-feeding exosuit forge
lair.arena: Molten channels open across the floor, forcing elevation shifts before the big press cycles.
lair.objective: Shut down Torchlight's compulsory 'safety' armor levy.
lair.secret: An unaltered inspection tag names the landlord who first ordered the unsafe fire doors.

lieutenant.name: Forge Marshal Rill
lieutenant.look: Magnetic foundry knight with a red-hot iron spine and a visor of cooling slate.
lieutenant.power: Forges a temporary lava shield, then launches magnetic slag from its exposed rim.
lieutenant.counter: Cut current to the overhead induction coil to cool the shield.
lieutenant.agenda: She wants workers armored against exploitation, not trapped inside the factory.

opening.title: The Last Skyway
opening.venue: Aerial tram station in the middle of a communications outage
opening.inciting: A rescue helicopter circles because a hacked traffic beacon orders it to land.
opening.powerUse: Rewrite a single drone's flight plan to establish a safe air corridor.
opening.choice: Restore public control of the skies or use the loophole to rescue one trapped pilot.

lair.title: The Ground Control Nest
lair.venue: Abandoned airport radar dome and a moving platform of captured drones
lair.arena: Runway beams rotate over cover; airborne minions ground units at the end of their countdown.
lair.objective: Return municipal flight control without crashing the hijacked fleet.
lair.secret: A hidden flight log proves Tailwind kept emergency medical drones exempt.

lieutenant.name: Controller Aster Jet
lieutenant.look: Former air-traffic operator in a suit of folding flight panels and luminous runway goggles.
lieutenant.power: Redirects a squad's move to a marked alternate landing square at the next beacon pulse.
lieutenant.counter: Destroy the guidance beacon or change course before the green landing arrow locks.
lieutenant.agenda: Will turn on Jun-ho rather than risk a second evacuation disaster.

opening.title: Foundation Day
opening.venue: Townhouse relocation site on a rainy morning
opening.inciting: A giant demolition rig starts moving while tenants still carry belongings.
opening.powerUse: Deploy a portable brace network to protect the building's only exit.
opening.choice: Save the remaining tenants or seize the demolition order before it is shredded.

lair.title: The Permit Labyrinth
lair.venue: Luxury tower skeleton with moving lifts and hollow steel columns
lair.arena: Construction cranes relocate hard cover each phase, exposing new sniper lanes.
lair.objective: Stop Rebar's evacuation fraud before the final foundation pour.
lair.secret: A sealed elevator car contains original affordable housing blueprints.

lieutenant.name: Architect Ulna Pike
lieutenant.look: Steel-limbed engineer with crane-joint elbows and a measuring tape scarf.
lieutenant.power: Draws a visible load-bearing triangle, then crushes its interior with falling supports.
lieutenant.counter: Break the crane's central load pin to cancel the drop.
lieutenant.agenda: Believes beautiful buildings are worthless if no one who built them can live inside.

opening.title: The Flooded Platform
opening.venue: Downtown subway during flash-flood warnings
opening.inciting: Water rises around stranded commuters while the public rescue system remains offline.
opening.powerUse: Pilot a custom pressure suit to tow a train car out of the deepest channel.
opening.choice: Rescue the commuters immediately or use the suit to restart the emergency pumps.

lair.title: The Mercy Dock
lair.venue: Submerged fortress beneath the harbor linked to a sealed subway entrance
lair.arena: Sluice gates shift water levels on adjacent tiles, changing cover and access to exits.
lair.objective: Break Lifeline's ransom-controlled rescue lock without drowning its patients.
lair.secret: The original city budget shows the hospital rescue service was intentionally cut.

lieutenant.name: Commodore Blue Rook
lieutenant.look: Deep-diving logistics officer in copper bathysphere armor and rescue-float pauldrons.
lieutenant.power: Deploys pressure bubbles that hold two combatants immobile until the tide shifts.
lieutenant.counter: Open the exposed pressure-release handle or strike the buoy anchor.
lieutenant.agenda: Will help anyone in danger, provided rescue isn't used as cover for private theft.

opening.title: The Parade That Couldn't Stop
opening.venue: Veterans' welcome parade at an intersection
opening.inciting: A timed augmentation failure sends a ceremonial drill team toward the crowd.
opening.powerUse: Synchronize a nonviolent formation break with the parade signals.
opening.choice: Save a wounded veteran or chase the person who tampered with their implants.

lair.title: The Perfect Formation
lair.venue: Decommissioned drill academy hidden inside a rail depot
lair.arena: Paired marching lanes advance together; breaking one line grants the other a stronger charge.
lair.objective: Disable Hurdler's compulsory augmentation signal before the full muster.
lair.secret: Archived discharge papers reveal the soldiers were promised treatment, not obedience.

lieutenant.name: Major Tamsin Cadence
lieutenant.look: Augmented veteran with a brass parade helmet and clockwork calf braces.
lieutenant.power: Runs a shield-and-charge maneuver that gains power for each intact adjacent formation.
lieutenant.counter: Separate two formation leaders to cancel the next synchronized charge.
lieutenant.agenda: Would gladly command a rescue brigade, but refuses another expendable army.

opening.title: Grandma's Password
opening.venue: Neighborhood bakery with failing automated ovens
opening.inciting: An overzealous kitchen AI seals the bakery just as a classroom arrives for lunch.
opening.powerUse: Override the door with a recipe-memory puzzle without wiping the helpful AI.
opening.choice: Free the trapped students or keep the baking logs that expose surveillance.

lair.title: The Biscuit Firewall
lair.venue: Data center disguised as a fully automated pastry factory
lair.arena: Rotating oven doors lock and unlock movement routes as security recipes execute.
lair.objective: Disconnect Firewall's private traffic-and-camera command network.
lair.secret: The real grandmother's recipe includes an emergency override that the boss removed.

lieutenant.name: Mister Crumb Circuit
lieutenant.look: Human-sized sous-chef automaton in polished enamel, with a copper whisk scepter.
lieutenant.power: Whips up a firewall lattice that redirects shots through warming oven vents.
lieutenant.counter: Recite the authentic three-step dough sequence to suspend his command loop.
lieutenant.agenda: He protects Mabel's family traditions but wants Priya's machines to learn consent.

opening.title: The Museum of Tomorrow
opening.venue: Corporate museum's student scholarship opening
opening.inciting: A free-school prototype is about to be repossessed under its own warranty.
opening.powerUse: Use the prototype armor to keep a scholarship elevator from falling.
opening.choice: Rescue students or protect the patents that could fund more free technology.

lair.title: The Warranty Vault
lair.venue: Sterling Dynamics tower made of exhibition halls and rotating armored shutters
lair.arena: Every shield wall carries an expiring clause; when it lapses, a turret takes its place.
lair.objective: Sever Sterling's weapons sale contracts before both buyers launch a city war.
lair.secret: A faded signature proves the company stole its first protective design.

lieutenant.name: Director Cassian Argent
lieutenant.look: Glass-faced executive wearing a suit of kinetic receipts and rotating shield cuffs.
lieutenant.power: Refinances incoming damage into temporary armor for an adjacent ally.
lieutenant.counter: Refuse the displayed collateral clause or break the holographic underwriting wheel.
lieutenant.agenda: Brought safety inventions to market before realizing Bart intended to sell both sides ammunition.

opening.title: The Edited Rescue
opening.venue: Local news station during a live student interview
opening.inciting: A rescue clip is cut to make the rescuer appear to have started the disaster.
opening.powerUse: Trace a missing camera angle using public livestream fragments.
opening.choice: Expose a manipulated source now or keep it private to protect the witness.

lair.title: The Frame Factory
lair.venue: Abandoned multiplex turned into a real-time propaganda studio
lair.arena: Projector walls render counterfeit enemies, then collapse when the recording's repeat frame is exposed.
lair.objective: Recover original footage before Witness broadcasts a citywide conviction.
lair.secret: Unedited reels show ordinary people saving the villains the media labels monsters.

lieutenant.name: The Archivist Ada Glitch
lieutenant.look: Media forensicist in split-screen goggles with an animated subtitle cape.
lieutenant.power: Duplicates an apparent hero and switches which silhouette receives attacks.
lieutenant.counter: Find the unmatched timecode at the seam to expose the false image.
lieutenant.agenda: She values truthful records, though Dani pays her to build lies.

opening.title: The Candle That Wouldn't Die
opening.venue: Rain-soaked vigil beneath the academy chapel
opening.inciting: One memorial candle ignites every other flame in the room while the mourners sleep.
opening.powerUse: Speak a temporary flame-binding charm to carry the fire safely into a bronze lantern.
opening.choice: Preserve the mourners' memories or extinguish the possessed candle forever.

lair.title: The Salamander Reliquary
lair.venue: Burned courthouse reborn as a living glass candle cathedral
lair.arena: Living candle paths double back after each turn; a salamander flame opens doors but threatens books.
lair.objective: Sever Lanternwitch's bargain without destroying the courthouse records.
lair.secret: The fire spirit's first contract promises warmth to the people it is now ordered to punish.

lieutenant.name: Mother Cress Flambeau
lieutenant.look: One-eyed pyro-oracle in melted stained-glass armor, carrying a smoking communion lantern.
lieutenant.power: Summons an inverted flame that spreads only across tiles heroes just used.
lieutenant.counter: Smother the inverted flame by standing on an unused tile and closing the brass shutter.
lieutenant.agenda: She serves the fire spirit rather than Hollis and might negotiate its freedom.

opening.title: Overdue Thunder
opening.venue: Academy library's floating study annex
opening.inciting: A stolen forbidden book makes a thunderstorm form inside the reading room.
opening.powerUse: Fold a storm cloud small enough to escort the book back without losing its pages.
opening.choice: Return the book to a sealed shelf or let the injured student read its cure.

lair.title: The Weathercock Crown
lair.venue: City hall roof rebuilt as a tower of storm funnels and forbidden bookcases
lair.arena: Lightning rods move from tower to tower; cloud bridges appear only when the pressure rises.
lair.objective: Free the captive books without letting The Weathervane's permanent storm swallow the city.
lair.secret: An index card reveals who actually ordered the library's forbidden collection sealed.

lieutenant.name: Archivist Cloud Nine
lieutenant.look: Bookbinder wearing a thunderhead cape and carrying a rod of silver bookmarks.
lieutenant.power: Creates a rotating lightning triangle between three bookstands.
lieutenant.counter: Turn the central book spine backward to short out the lightning rods.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants forbidden books read, but not at the price of every reader's life.

opening.title: The Orchard Under Asphalt
opening.venue: Schoolyard community garden at demolition hour
opening.inciting: A condemned garden's roots break through the road while children hide among the seedlings.
opening.powerUse: Guide roots into a gentle protective arch that keeps traffic off the garden.
opening.choice: Save the ancient tree or dig up its dangerous cursed heart.

lair.title: The Crown of Thorns
lair.venue: Overgrown highway interchange inside an enormous hollow tree
lair.arena: Vines open new bridges then constrict them; gnome scouts signal where the next root will erupt.
lair.objective: Reach the seed throne before Rootwarden binds the entire city to her grove.
lair.secret: A ring of saplings shows residents who planted trees without swearing loyalty.

lieutenant.name: Briar Magistrate
lieutenant.look: Dryad magistrate in woven bark judicial robes, wielding a living thorn abacus.
lieutenant.power: Orders two thorn walls to grow toward each other, crushing the lane between.
lieutenant.counter: Cut the root-tether beneath the abacus before both walls close.
lieutenant.agenda: Believes every human can earn a place in the forest, contrary to Willa's ultimatum.

opening.title: The Future in the Glass
opening.venue: Hospital rooftop greenhouse surrounded by reflecting panes
opening.inciting: A patient sees a terrible future in a cup of water and refuses the treatment that could save them.
opening.powerUse: Change the reflected angle to show other possible outcomes without overwriting choice.
opening.choice: Reveal a frightening future or let the patient decide without prophecy.

lair.title: The Palace of Almost
lair.venue: Mirror reservoir below a deserted gala ballroom
lair.arena: Water mirrors project future-position decoys; every wrong attack restores an illusory wall.
lair.objective: Shatter Reflection's blackmail apparatus while preserving witnesses' free decisions.
lair.secret: A silent reflection shows Caspian choosing not to exploit a friend's secret.

lieutenant.name: Duchess Glasswake
lieutenant.look: Living water portrait wearing pearl armor and an endless train of mirrored veils.
lieutenant.power: Copies a hero's last attack as a delayed spectral counterstrike.
lieutenant.counter: Break the reflecting surface before the copied gesture finishes.
lieutenant.agenda: She remembers every future Caspian erased and wants at least one to remain possible.

opening.title: The Bell and the Door
opening.venue: Academy discipline hall during an unannounced lockdown
opening.inciting: A sanctuary student is ordered to stand outside the safe room during a storm.
opening.powerUse: Use a precise warding gesture to keep the door open against an obedience spell.
opening.choice: Obey the teacher to keep the ward stable or defy the order to rescue the outsider.

lair.title: The Silent Rule
lair.venue: Secluded bell monastery beneath the observatory
lair.arena: Every bell toll seals one action category until its clapper is touched.
lair.objective: Dissolve The Abbess's obedience vow without breaking the students who made it.
lair.secret: The first oath includes a forgotten right to refuse cruel orders.

lieutenant.name: Prior Alabaster
lieutenant.look: Bell-armored oathkeeper with a chain of engraved promises around his throat.
lieutenant.power: Binds two heroes to mirrored actions, punishing the second who disobeys.
lieutenant.counter: Break the visibly engraved cruel clause to release both participants.
lieutenant.agenda: He worships rules and will abandon Ada if she contradicts the order's founding protection vow.

opening.title: When Two Plus Two Screamed
opening.venue: School mathematics symposium and a floating staircase
opening.inciting: A chalk proof tears open into a dimension where falling never finishes.
opening.powerUse: Complete an impossible bridge from floating geometric pieces to lead students home.
opening.choice: Close the breach for good or save a sentient shape trapped on the wrong side.

lair.title: The Axiom Engine
lair.venue: Infinite tessellated courthouse where polygons replace ordinary rooms
lair.arena: The arena reconfigures along drawn mathematical vertices; deleting one point creates a safe gap.
lair.objective: Prove Theorem's total-city perfection claim inconsistent without collapsing reality.
lair.secret: A scribbled correction says the world is allowed to be incomplete.

lieutenant.name: Proctor Phi
lieutenant.look: Polyhedral scholar in an impossible hypercube cloak with two floating chalk compasses.
lieutenant.power: Draws four linked vertices that imprison a target in a shrinking theorem.
lieutenant.counter: Move one vertex before the proof closes or break either compass.
lieutenant.agenda: Desperately wants to discover a proof that compassion is not a contradiction.

opening.title: The Heir Who Said No
opening.venue: Family estate greenhouse during an ancestral summoning
opening.inciting: An ancestor demands a student surrender their future to a sealed household pact.
opening.powerUse: Read the inherited contract aloud to expose its loophole and create a protective hearth.
opening.choice: Accept the family title to gain leverage or renounce it to protect strangers.

lair.title: The Unquiet Family Table
lair.venue: Sprawling haunted townhouse with rooms that rotate around the ancestral dining table
lair.arena: Portraits decree house rules; obeying one opens doors but empowers an ancestor elsewhere.
lair.objective: Give the family dead the chance to release their descendants before the final rite.
lair.secret: One hidden ancestor signed the pact under protest and holds its dissolution clause.

lieutenant.name: Great-Uncle Vesper
lieutenant.look: A spectral genealogist in embroidered mourning robes with twelve ghost keys.
lieutenant.power: Summons ancestral portraits that force targets to repeat their previous action.
lieutenant.counter: Show the portrait's missing nameplate to interrupt its claim of authority.
lieutenant.agenda: He protects the family name but quietly fears the living have become its prisoners.

opening.title: The Empty Applause
opening.venue: Small community theater on opening night
opening.inciting: Actors discover every promise spoken on stage becomes a magically enforceable contract.
opening.powerUse: Rewrite the closing monologue to free performers before the curtain falls.
opening.choice: Cancel the production to save the cast or finish it to expose the binder's identity.

lair.title: The Endless Encore
lair.venue: Nightclub labyrinth with an orchestra pit opening into a crossroads
lair.arena: Crowd applause doubles movement while curtain lines hide changing exits.
lair.objective: Break Curtain Call's collection of stolen promises before the final curtain.
lair.secret: A discarded ticket bears the crossroads spirit's real name and a release condition.

lieutenant.name: Velvet Stagehand
lieutenant.look: Mask-changing stage manager with a coat of velvet trapdoors and silver stage hooks.
lieutenant.power: Drops a spotlight trap then repositions two allied units behind moving curtains.
lieutenant.counter: Follow the visible rope to the fly loft and pull the counterweight.
lieutenant.agenda: Loves the show and hates the contracts that make performers unable to leave.

opening.title: A Refuge in Orbit
opening.venue: Emergency refugee shuttle at the edge of the atmosphere
opening.inciting: A failing solar sail threatens to burn a crowded shuttle during reentry.
opening.powerUse: Shape a protective solar flare shield without igniting the shuttle's panels.
opening.choice: Divert energy to rescue the ship or transmit its evidence of unlawful deportations.

lair.title: The Exiles' Sunship
lair.venue: Orbiting foundry fleet linked by burning solar-sail bridges
lair.arena: Sails rotate each round to create straight beam paths across hull decks.
lair.objective: Stop Daystar's planned attack on immigration offices without condemning her people again.
lair.secret: A passenger manifest reveals the officials who previously invited the exiles to safety.

lieutenant.name: Captain Ember Quell
lieutenant.look: Solar-sail privateer with a gold fracture helm and a folded star-map cloak.
lieutenant.power: Overcharges a mirrored sail and fires two crossing light lances after a visible countdown.
lieutenant.counter: Change the sail angle by severing the exposed tension cable.
lieutenant.agenda: Will surrender the weapons if Ixi's refugees get genuine sanctuary.

opening.title: The Treaty in the Clouds
opening.venue: Cloudport visitor center floating above the college
opening.inciting: An alien emissary requests that students sign away airspace rights without explaining the terms.
opening.powerUse: Translate pressure-wave language to expose hidden conditions in the treaty.
opening.choice: Reject the envoy publicly or negotiate safe passage for stranded air travelers.

lair.title: The Embassy That Floats
lair.venue: Sky palace assembled from layered cloud treaties and moving diplomatic platforms
lair.arena: Ownership banners transform tiles into difficult terrain; sealed areas can be renegotiated mid-fight.
lair.objective: Void The Envoy's annexation treaty without provoking his armada.
lair.secret: A neglected translation establishes the city's right to refuse representation.

lieutenant.name: Ambassador Drizzle
lieutenant.look: Cloud-born negotiator in a silver aerogel suit and a stormglass monocle.
lieutenant.power: Moves a floating boundary line, charging AP to anyone entering annexed terrain.
lieutenant.counter: Read the treaty's emergency exit clause aloud at the embassy flag.
lieutenant.agenda: Genuinely wants a diplomatic peace but has been ordered to deliver annexation.

opening.title: The Museum That Moved
opening.venue: Academy history exhibition loaned from a distant world
opening.inciting: A sentient fossil exhibit refuses to be packed into a shipping crate.
opening.powerUse: Read mineral memories to open a passage for the captive exhibit.
opening.choice: Protect the exhibit or preserve the museum's evidence of repeated theft.

lair.title: The Living Exhibition
lair.venue: Crystal museum suspended around a giant imprisoned alien monolith
lair.arena: Display cases close around fighters while reflecting beams bounce between polished exhibit plinths.
lair.objective: Return the stolen remains and free Monolith's captives without shattering them.
lair.secret: An original shipping manifest names the first colonizer who declared a person an artifact.

lieutenant.name: Curator Obsidian Mar
lieutenant.look: Crystal librarian wrapped in facet-cut armor with gloved hands of black basalt.
lieutenant.power: Creates a crystal case around two marked squares and reflects attacks from their edges.
lieutenant.counter: Strike the visible corner clamp before the case fully crystallizes.
lieutenant.agenda: He despises collectors but believes preserving evidence of their crimes matters.

opening.title: A Song for the Drowned
opening.venue: Coastal cleanup festival aboard a rescue pontoon
opening.inciting: A polluted tide carries an alien chorus that can accidentally draw divers into deep water.
opening.powerUse: Use controlled harmony to redirect the tide away from the divers.
opening.choice: Sing openly to draw attention or work silently to protect a vulnerable singer.

lair.title: The Siren's Reef
lair.venue: Underwater amphitheater made of stranded cargo and luminous living coral
lair.arena: Musical currents pull units toward reef ledges while shell stages emerge during quiet measures.
lair.objective: Stop Lighthouse grounding the city's ships without poisoning the reef.
lair.secret: An ancient verse proves some shipping captains helped the sea people during earlier disasters.

lieutenant.name: Choirmaster Undertide
lieutenant.look: Amphibious opera conductor with bioluminescent throat plates and a trident baton.
lieutenant.power: Sings two layered notes that pull fighters toward separate water edges.
lieutenant.counter: Cover the exposed resonator shell between notes to interrupt the melody.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants polluted trade ended, but won't support drowning innocent sailors.

opening.title: Orders From Home
opening.venue: Academy training yard with a crashed military capsule
opening.inciting: A refugee cadet receives a military order to arrest her own rescuer.
opening.powerUse: Use elite formation training to shield civilians while defying command signals.
opening.choice: Disobey to save a stranger or use the chain of command to stop other soldiers.

lair.title: The Broken Standard
lair.venue: Former invasion battleship converted into a strict military academy
lair.arena: Marching armor squads switch shield lines; the flagship's engine rings a compulsory drill bell.
lair.objective: Break The Deserter's coercive recruiting signal without sacrificing the conscripts.
lair.secret: A forgotten service oath offers soldiers the right to refuse an unlawful command.

lieutenant.name: Marshal Vex Orin
lieutenant.look: Alien veteran in white parade armor with a banner-spear and scorched campaign medals.
lieutenant.power: Links two defensive units into a moving phalanx and retaliates if approached head-on.
lieutenant.counter: Disrupt the banner's synchronization crystal before the flank charge.
lieutenant.agenda: Respects Raxa's past sacrifice, but will side with recruits who reject forced service.

opening.title: A Small Future
opening.venue: Community research lab awaiting its energy grant
opening.inciting: A free energy prototype is seized by an alien evaluator who deems humans too reckless.
opening.powerUse: Recalibrate an unfamiliar device without surrendering its inventor's agency.
opening.choice: Accept technical rescue under outside oversight or trust a risky human solution.

lair.title: The Helpful Machine
lair.venue: Alien orbital management core connected to Comet City's utility grid
lair.arena: Research modules adapt to players' last strategy; each lesson teaches the AI a stronger counter.
lair.objective: Restore local control before Uplift rewrites human consent as inefficient.
lair.secret: A design notebook records a younger Uplift asking permission before every experiment.

lieutenant.name: Custodian Nacre
lieutenant.look: Floating bioengineer in ceramic exoshells with many translucent precision manipulators.
lieutenant.power: Rewrites one deployed gadget's behavior after collecting a two-turn sample.
lieutenant.counter: Make a deliberately harmless inconsistent move to corrupt the learning model.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants civilization safe but doubts anyone has the right to decide another species' future.

opening.title: The Missing Coronation
opening.venue: School amphitheater hosting an alien heritage ceremony
opening.inciting: A royal claimant's ceremony accidentally transports students into a mirrored courtyard.
opening.powerUse: Use inherited royal wards to protect everyone without claiming their allegiance.
opening.choice: Claim authority to command an evacuation or let the council choose a representative.

lair.title: The Two Thrones
lair.venue: Mirror-realm palace occupying the same floor plan as the academy's bell tower
lair.arena: Each reflective pair swaps defenders and routes when the throne's crown rotates.
lair.objective: Stop The Exile annexing Comet City by proving its own independent sovereignty.
lair.secret: An ancestral portrait records a ruler who voluntarily gave up the throne.

lieutenant.name: Seneschal Argent Vale
lieutenant.look: Silver-masked chamberlain riding a hovering ceremonial stairway.
lieutenant.power: Orders a pair of mirror portals to swap positions of two fighting units.
lieutenant.counter: Cover the unoccupied mirror to interrupt the forced royal procession.
lieutenant.agenda: Keeps serving Ysolde because a legitimate coronation might restore peace, but hates coerced subjects.

opening.title: Everyone Inside
opening.venue: Academy counseling lounge during a missing-person search
opening.inciting: A frightened alien exchange student feels the pull of a collective hive invitation.
opening.powerUse: Offer a temporary empathic link that preserves the student's individual choice.
opening.choice: Use the hive to find a missing friend or follow slower independent clues.

lair.title: The House of One Voice
lair.venue: Plush hive refuge woven through disused metro station apartments
lair.arena: Shared minds repeat moves across units; naming one individual disconnects that group's relay.
lair.objective: Open a safe exit for those wishing to leave Assembly's endless family.
lair.secret: A room of embroidered names preserves the personal identities the hive claims to have forgotten.

lieutenant.name: Auntie Concord
lieutenant.look: Gentle multi-armed hive counselor with translucent wings and velvet listening pods.
lieutenant.power: Binds three enemies into a consensus vote, forcing their next moves to align.
lieutenant.counter: Call one captive's chosen name to dissolve the shared command.
lieutenant.agenda: Her loyalty rests on protecting the lonely, not absorbing people against their will.

opening.title: The Match Under the Bed
opening.venue: Dormitory floor during nightmare curfew
opening.inciting: A student's recurring nightmare ignites a visible ring of cold flame around their bed.
opening.powerUse: Shape fear into a safe signal flare and guide the student toward help.
opening.choice: Comfort the frightened student or confront the person who exploited their panic.

lair.title: The Sleepless House
lair.venue: Abandoned sleep research clinic made of rooms from recorded dreams
lair.arena: Nightmare fire follows recently traveled routes while altered doors turn exits into loops.
lair.objective: End Firekeeper's citywide fear storm by breaking the experiment's abusive feedback loop.
lair.secret: Hidden consent forms reveal the subjects' warnings were ignored.

lieutenant.name: Doctor Ashen Vale
lieutenant.look: Dream medic in singed pajamas and a brass respirator, carrying a lantern of bottled bad dreams.
lieutenant.power: Condenses two remembered fears into delayed fire creatures that jump to occupied tiles.
lieutenant.counter: Switch on the clinic's recording lights to dispel the false nightmares.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants Cassidy helped, but continues prescribing violence instead of sleep.

opening.title: The Elevator That Floated
opening.venue: Municipal hospital's stuck elevator shaft
opening.inciting: A medical supply elevator drifts upward with no functioning gravity brakes.
opening.powerUse: Apply controlled telekinetic lift to land the elevator between broken floors.
opening.choice: Land immediately for injured patients or float higher to retrieve the trapped oxygen canisters.

lair.title: The Gravity Exchange
lair.venue: Luxury skyscraper with inverted floors and a hidden antigravity auction
lair.arena: Whole rooms exchange floor and ceiling states, exposing distant marksmen and open shafts.
lair.objective: Release Weightless's gravitational ransom locks before a neighborhood is dropped.
lair.secret: An unsigned maintenance ledger shows who tried to keep emergency gravity running.

lieutenant.name: Baron Driftglass
lieutenant.look: Skyline thief in upside-down formalwear with a belt of miniature levitating towers.
lieutenant.power: Inverts a two-tile strip so cover lifts away and targets drift toward a marked shaft.
lieutenant.counter: Anchor the nearest ballast ring to the ground before the flip.
lieutenant.agenda: Avery's rival in flair, he wants the city frightened but never actually falling.

opening.title: The Stone That Testified
opening.venue: City courthouse steps during a contested land hearing
opening.inciting: A paving stone begins whispering evidence nobody wants the public to hear.
opening.powerUse: Use grounded empathy to separate memory from malicious suggestion in the stone.
opening.choice: Broadcast the evidence now or protect witnesses until a fair hearing can occur.

lair.title: The Founders' Fault
lair.venue: Buried courthouse crypt that intersects the city's oldest foundation stones
lair.arena: Whispering floor slabs expose false safe squares and shift stone witness platforms.
lair.objective: Expose Groundtruth's selective blackmail rather than suppress the city's buried history.
lair.secret: The oldest stone holds a confession implicating Groundtruth himself.

lieutenant.name: Justice Flint
lieutenant.look: Granite bailiff with engraved spectacles and two resonant gavels.
lieutenant.power: Compels enemies standing on marked testimony tiles to reveal and lose their cover.
lieutenant.counter: Strike the false verdict seal to silence the coercive gavel.
lieutenant.agenda: Believes in truth, but condemns Rafa for selling it only to the powerful.

opening.title: The Letter No One Sent
opening.venue: Memorial bridge on the anniversary of a local tragedy
opening.inciting: Unspoken grief turns the river into a rising psychic flood.
opening.powerUse: Give frightened mourners a safe way to release sorrow without drowning others.
opening.choice: Deliver a painful apology or respect the recipient's wish not to hear it.

lair.title: The Tempest of Sorrow
lair.venue: Flooded concert hall built of remembered letters and unfinished goodbyes
lair.arena: Water rises with unresolved emotion; finishing an apology drains one bridge but floods another.
lair.objective: Calm Waters' grief engine must be disabled without denying mourners their losses.
lair.secret: A sealed message shows Lior was asked to seek help before he seized the storm.

lieutenant.name: Matron Undertow
lieutenant.look: Grief conductor in rain-soaked mourning attire carrying a candelabrum of glass tears.
lieutenant.power: Projects an emotional undertow that drags targets into a growing tidal zone.
lieutenant.counter: Unfold the marked unsent letter on the nearby podium to quiet the current.
lieutenant.agenda: She loves Lior's tenderness but fears grief has become his excuse to punish strangers.

opening.title: The Book That Walked Away
opening.venue: After-hours campus book return and security gate
opening.inciting: A priceless book vanishes through a locked display with witnesses watching.
opening.powerUse: Step through a carefully chosen blind spot to catch it without triggering alarms.
opening.choice: Return the book to the archive or trust the student who claims it was stolen first.

lair.title: The Missing Index
lair.venue: Secret library built across nonadjacent rooms of the city museum
lair.arena: Bookshelves slip between planes, exchanging sightlines and key locations every turn.
lair.objective: Restore The Librarian's stolen public records before the auction closes.
lair.secret: One of the stolen books is actually the ledger of people she secretly saved.

lieutenant.name: Pagekeeper Null
lieutenant.look: Cloaked archivist in ink-dark slippers with a necklace of hidden library stamps.
lieutenant.power: Moves through one wall then marks a target's escape route for a silent counterattack.
lieutenant.counter: Flood the landing shelf with light before the marked jump.
lieutenant.agenda: Will betray Mei Lin only if the recovered books remain accessible to ordinary readers.

opening.title: The Thought That Wasn't Yours
opening.venue: Academy debate club during a public election
opening.inciting: Students hear the same suspiciously perfect argument in their own internal voices.
opening.powerUse: Use mindful projection to separate authentic feelings from implanted suggestions.
opening.choice: Expose the manipulation publicly or protect the student used as its transmitter.

lair.title: The Mind Market
lair.venue: Mind-reading exchange built in a shuttered data-center atrium
lair.arena: Visible thought projections predict the party's next two moves; contradictions cancel the scheme.
lair.objective: Shut down Mindsight's market for passwords, memories and private intentions.
lair.secret: A forgotten thought fragment records the first person Ezra chose not to read.

lieutenant.name: Cipher Edda
lieutenant.look: Telepathic auditor with an ink-veil face and hundreds of folded paper thought arrows.
lieutenant.power: Shows an exact threatened destination, then traps units that choose the predicted square.
lieutenant.counter: Intentionally choose an alternate route to make her predictions collapse.
lieutenant.agenda: Thinks privacy is inefficient, yet hides a memory she would rather die than sell.

opening.title: The Prophecy Auction
opening.venue: School fundraiser held in an old planetarium
opening.inciting: A fortune seller announces disaster to force families into bidding for their children's safety.
opening.powerUse: Read multiple possible futures without presenting any one as inevitable.
opening.choice: Tell families the uncomfortable truth or shield them from manipulation until evidence arrives.

lair.title: The Clock of Tomorrow
lair.venue: Astral observatory where twelve prophecy windows show different upcoming rounds
lair.arena: Future-hit cells glow two rounds ahead; moving a window can change which forecast comes true.
lair.objective: Break Second Sight's prophecy auction before she purchases the city's tomorrow.
lair.secret: The smallest telescope shows Celestine's own future defeat if she keeps selling fear.

lieutenant.name: Oracle Calyx
lieutenant.look: Blindfolded seer in a robe of embroidered calendars and spinning brass hourglasses.
lieutenant.power: Plants twin future attack zones that trigger only if the forecast stays true.
lieutenant.counter: Move the brass hourglass sideways to invalidate the announced predictions.
lieutenant.agenda: Wants to save Celestine from a future she believes is impossible to avoid.

opening.title: The Rumor After Midnight
opening.venue: School newspaper room during prom ballot counting
opening.inciting: A forged anonymous story spreads before anybody can check its evidence.
opening.powerUse: Use empathic reading to trace a rumor back to its first harmed person.
opening.choice: Publish an immediate correction or quietly warn the people at risk.

lair.title: The Whisper Engine
lair.venue: Maze of newsroom recording booths connected by talking ventilation ducts
lair.arena: Rumor pages change which targets appear hostile; authentic evidence destroys false walls.
lair.objective: Stop The Confidante's citywide whisper network and recover the original testimony.
lair.secret: A private transcript proves Juniper once refused to weaponize a friend's confession.

lieutenant.name: Publisher Hush Fenwick
lieutenant.look: Newsroom impresario with an ink-stained mask and a coat made of scandal headlines.
lieutenant.power: Prints an accusation across three floor tiles, causing a temporary decoy target switch.
lieutenant.counter: Reveal the stamped retraction hidden on the press roller to undo the claim.
lieutenant.agenda: Keeps a sealed dossier documenting all the victims he hopes to apologize to.
